gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmon: A high-set x-height and rounds with a small gap make this plain sans read crisp and current. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong does the quiet everyday reading, while Vast Shadow, with no hairlines anywhere, brings the vintage show.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene leaves its curves unclosed and trims its ascenders short. Noto Sans Palmyrene is the one for reading, while Vast Shadow, drawn by a pen that never shifts pressure, is the one for looking.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Open-ended curves and a short step up to capitals give this plain sans an easygoing read. And Vast Shadow, its drafting-pen outlines all one nib width, gives Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau a vintage frame.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Approachable is the mood of Noto Sans PhagsPa, with see-through c openings. Beside it, Vast Shadow keeps every stroke at a single thickness, so its vintage showiness stays crisp while the body's capitals rise only gently.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Vintage swagger, and not a single hairline to squint at: that's Vast Shadow. And Noto Sans Phoenician, with generous lowercase and s curves flaring at both ends, feels modern beside it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pah: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping mouths on its e and capitals that barely rise. But Vast Shadow cuts every stroke with zero modulation, so the two meet as vintage showpiece and approachable sans.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Vast Shadow is vintage and eye-catching, built from tubular, wire-like letterforms in a single stroke width with a tall mean line. Wire for show; Noto Sans Rejang, with porthole counters, for reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-runic: Vast Shadow draws each letter with no stroke modulation at all, vintage and eye-catching. Noto Sans Runic, whose curves never close back on themselves, makes pages of text feel modern and unforced.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Approachable describes the body here: curves full of daylight and a hefty lowercase. Noto Sans Samaritan carries the text, while Vast Shadow, uppercase built from lines of one constant thickness, handles the vintage spectacle.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra barely lets a capital stand taller than its neighbors. Beside Vast Shadow, all straight-edged constant strokes, that restraint is the whole point: one loud and vintage, one clean and quiet.
